summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO spanning the Lantern March and its streamed frontier campaigns. MMORPG Tools owns character, realm and UI lifecycle; ordered player behaviors combine movement, classes, quests, trade and flight, while scene bindings and YAML registries define world content. Each realm is a separate room with its own live world and character roster; shared SQL holds saved heroes, population pulses and realm-first records.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - realm selection and front door for entering the world or opening character creation.
places/character-creation-land/ - race/class/appearance selection with preview character and creation camera.
places/main/config.yaml - continent terrain, regional flattening, roads, scatter and atmosphere; streamed cells contribute local sites and interactions.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub, residents, services, quests, Shield Table, Observatory and major chapter sites.
places/main/cells/x-9z0.scene - Briarwild Deepgrove clearing, Fenna's camp, BRD quest NPCs/marks and grove-built landmarks.

places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene, x-5z0.scene, x-5z1.scene, x-6z0.scene, x0z-1.scene, x1z0.scene, x7z-1..-2.scene, x2z11.scene and frontier cells - Briarwild, northern March, Emberstone, Saltmere and other continent landmarks/campaigns.
places/main/cells/x-9z6.scene, x-10z6..8.scene, x-11z6..7.scene, x-10z15.scene and x-5z16..x-9z15.scene - Sorrowfen and Tideglass Coast campaign regions.
places/hollowcrypt/ - separate underground dungeon entered from the mausoleum in main; cells hold crypt halls, archive, Warden, Vale/Elric, candles and echoes.
roots: world.config.yaml - main-menu-land default entry; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, cameras, character/interaction behaviors and UI actions.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, Vanguard, Arcanist, Pathfinder, Shade, quest, vendor, flight and vitality behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera template; MMORPG has separate creation and menu camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml - owns continent terrain and regional surface/scatter configuration; cells supply local structures and interactions.
places/hollowcrypt/config.yaml - owns dungeon gravity, dark atmosphere, lighting and place configuration; cells bind crypt geometry and encounters.
mods/gavi/mod.json - registers Gavi crew behavior and panel, the builder-facing companion tools.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors, gameplay scripts and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character load/upsert/delete, roster population, realm list and selected-realm detail shared by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - six-room roster/config read by routing and realm-pulse; realm-save.js maintains the matching room/name/type/note list.

scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest definitions and eligibility/progress/status shared by quest-player, quest-giver and quest UI; includes origin, SHA, EQU/DHC, SOR, TID and BRD campaigns.
scripts/lib/economy.js + MMORPG lib/currency.js - integer-copper transactions/ledger and denomination formatting shared by quests, vendor, flight and UI.
scripts/lib/regions.js + scripts/terrain-reach.js - regional classification and continent height/material generation used by terrain and region display, including Deepgrove, Sorrowfen and Tideglass.
scripts/lib/data/flights.yml - roost coordinates, regions, discovery radius, fare/speed limits and clearance read by flight behavior and UI.
scripts/lib/leveling.js + scripts/lib/data/levels.yml - total-XP progression and derived level/stats shared by quest-player and HUD/frame XP displays.
notableExports: scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; crons/realm-pulse.js - cron.
MMORPG main-menu-mgr.js - roster selection/hydration and lifecycle; character-select.js - preview lifecycle/input; player.js - character build/save/load lifecycle.
MMORPG ui.js - UI composition/actions; lib/ui-quest.js - quest dialog/tracker renderers; lib/ui-herald.js - renderHerald; lib/version.js - version/title/tag (0.27.0 Alpha).
MMORPG lib/realm-save.js - realm list/detail refresh, roster persistence and realm metadata; lib/ui-character-roster.js - renderCharacterRoster.
MMORPG lib/ui-hud.js - renderTargetDisplay, renderHUD; class-aware action bar presents kit/cooldowns in slots 1–3 unless saved spellBar entries override.
scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - gait; scripts/vitality.js - scheduled fall/rise and health-mending update.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput/update; scripts/lib/realm-firsts.js - questFirst, levelFirst; scripts/db.js - migrate.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - class combat handlers; scripts/shade.js - onInput, land, update, veiled, unveil, endAction; scripts/lib/kit.js - class/combat helpers.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.

MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including discovered roosts and quest state; realm-save also patches realmList/realmDetail UI state.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js, pathfinder.js and shade.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; Shade stores veiledUntil on player state and transient readiness/ambush windows in session.

scripts/quest-player.js - quest/tally, inventory/xp/dialog/cache state, quest marks/flags, deferred owedItems and quest travel transitions; derives level/xp progress/max stats from XP and persists changed character state.
scripts/lib/realm-firsts.js - claims one realm/feat first in SQL; a winning claim writes the room-wide world.state.herald announcement.
scripts/lib/leveling.js - derives level, XP within level, next-level requirement and max health/mana; levels.yml owns progression anchors, growth, cap and stat increments.
scripts/lib/economy.js - coin movement, purse floor and ledger writes; scripts/vendor.js owns shop state and transaction handling.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → main gameplay lifecycle.

Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to menu; menu Enter/Create and scripts/crypt-gate.js stamp transition exceptions.
main-menu-mgr loads current room SQL roster and population; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main.

scripts/lib/data/realms.yml → scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js; each room cron writes its player count to realm_pulse using SQLite unix time, and realm-save.js reads it (older than 180 s = quiet/zero).

realm-save refreshRealmList → player.state.realmList: pulse/character counts and global hero counts drive population, awake and least-populated-Normal recommendation; realmDetail queries top five heroes and recent realm_firsts for realmPick.
main-menu-mgr realm-list actions → realm-save refreshes selection detail; joinRealm refuses a displayed Full realm, otherwise api.cross enters its room; realm-save and realms.yml room IDs must agree.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js race start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to characters keyed by user, realm and slot; each realm has an independent roster.

templates/player.js order → locomotion → movement → class handlers including Shade → quest-player → vendor → flight → vitality; moveX/moveZ/jump and camera intents are consumed by player.js/wow-move.js under place gravity.
Interact/E → quest-player resolves NPCs, talkers, readable props, caches, timber and quest marks; quests.yml → quest-data eligibility/progress/status → quest-player and quest-giver/UI.

Quest completion and level-band crossing in quest-player → realm-firsts questFirst/levelFirst → race-safe INSERT OR IGNORE into realm_firsts; only the winner writes world.state.herald and emits realm-wide horn/stat events.
world.state.herald → MMORPG ui.js calls ui-herald.renderHerald on the gameplay HUD; banner displays each id once for 7 s, with the first herald on a page load remembered rather than shown.
Attack/cast inputs → class abilities and scripts/lib/missiles.js → targets/enemies; wolves.js, scavengers.js and candle-warden.js consume combat state and issue damage/kill credits.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/ landmark builders reuse scripts/gen/shape.js procedural geometry helpers, varied by landmark and parameters; crypt.js supplies Hollowcrypt halls, rooms and furniture.
scripts/gen/fen.js - procedural marsh props reused by Sorrowfen cells, varied by kind/seed/LOD; boardwalk geometry and collider share length/width/elevation parameters.
scripts/gen/tide.js - Tideglass structures and props share shape helpers; kind/LOD/length/width vary each piece.
scripts/gen/unseen.js - Old Bond House, yard wall, mirrors, case, dead drops and quest props share procedural geometry/material helpers, varied by params.kind and LOD.
scripts/gen/grove.js - Deepgrove gate, spiral tree, shrine, archive, roots, blight and props share shape emitters; params.kind/seed and LOD vary pieces.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, mushroom.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by layer density, scale, seed or per-item params.
scripts/gen/tree.js with scripts/tree-look.js - painted bark/alpha-cut foliage recur in forest layers and placed scatters, varied by tree kind and LOD.
MMORPG player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json; camera phases and lib/ui-* renderers are modular and composed by ui.js.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through scripts/lib/economy.js to preserve purse floor, ledger and UI feedback.
templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion before movement, then class handlers including Shade, quests, vendor, flight and vitality; gait samples prior-tick velocity.
Movement intent/locomotion scratch is room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.
state.xp remains cumulative while xpInto/xpToLevel are current-bar values; levels.yml owns total-XP anchors and progression cap 60.

realm_pulse.at uses SQLite unix seconds, shared with its freshness query; do not substitute a room-local clock. realm_firsts PRIMARY KEY (realm,feat) plus INSERT OR IGNORE arbitrates simultaneous first claims.
Shade Veil uses player.state.veiledUntil; wolves, scavengers and Candle Warden explicitly filter active Veil, so keep the key and expiry comparison aligned with Shade's timer state.
